fields.Name: T103 - Knowledge Hub Visualize
fields.Description: Opens the Knowledge Hub Visualize screen once, then walks its distinct code paths (Clusters/Tag Cloud mode toggle, cluster-analysis generation), verifying each via checkpoints. Consolidates old T255-T256.

InputDefinition.goal: Assume you are already logged in. Switch to the Knowledge Hub app via the application switcher dropdown next to the logo, then click 'Visualize' in the left nav (fa-circle-nodes icon). Then walk these sections IN ORDER, and as you arrive at each set "checkpointReached" to the exact checkpoint name shown: (1) visualize-mode-toggle - the toolbar has a mode switch with two tabs (Clusters and Tag Cloud); confirm the default mode renders its visualization, then click the other mode and confirm the main area swaps to that visualization (an empty/loading visualization still counts as the mode rendering); (2) cluster-analysis - select the 'Clusters' mode, use the floating cluster config panel to pick a source entity/document, and click the control that runs the clustering (Run/Generate); confirm a loading state then a scatter plot with cluster metrics (Records / Clusters / Silhouette) renders, OR a clear run-error banner explains why (a valid empty/no-data state also counts), and confirm the 'Saved Visualizations' sidebar is present (do NOT save). Keep going until both sections have been visited. Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment - wait for content rather than navigating away.

checkpoints.name: visualize-mode-toggle
checkpoints.instruction: toggle the Visualize mode between Clusters and Tag Cloud
visualCriteria: The Visualize screen loads with a mode switch offering Clusters and Tag Cloud, and clicking the alternate mode swaps the main area to that visualization (each rendering or showing a valid empty/loading state)

checkpoints.name: cluster-analysis
checkpoints.instruction: run clustering and see the scatter/metrics or a run-error banner
visualCriteria: The Clusters view shows a config panel, a scatter area, and a 'Saved Visualizations' sidebar; running clustering produces a loading state then a scatter plot + metrics (Records / Clusters / Silhouette), OR a clear run-error banner (a valid empty/no-data state also counts)
